random_masks: Per-frame stable SHA256(pair_id + profile) seed, independent Bernoulli removal of10% or30% of originally positive pixels; set to0 before recomputing1st/99th-percentile normalisation.
central_hole: Zero a central rectangle with half native width and half native height; geometric area about25%, actual positive-pixel loss recorded separately.
rules: All nine previously fitted outer models and gates frozen. Regenerate corrupted depth descriptors from native files; RGB unchanged. The score-profile gate observes only the newly corrupted one-frame score before allocation. Existing RGB-only decisions remain unchanged. No corruption-specific tuning.
scope: Artificial stress tests on the same source events, not new cattle, sensor calibrations, physical noise validation or independent field evidence.
zero_depth_case: Complete missing-depth handling falls back to RGB and is reported as handling, not evidence of a learned robustness gain. No synthetic scores or labels.
